title: Colour hunt
offscreen: In the following days, play without the tablet: "I spy something... yellow". Take turns: the child chooses the colour too.

items.label: Something red
items.say: Look around the house for something red and bring it here.

items.label: Something yellow
items.say: And now something yellow, like the sun.

items.label: Something green
items.say: Look for something green and bring it here.

items.label: Something orange
items.say: Something orange: that's tricky, look carefully.

items.label: Something brown
items.say: Look for something brown, like wood.

items.label: Something purple
items.say: Now something purple. Is there one in the house?

items.label: Something with lots of colours
items.say: And now something with lots of colours together.

intro.bo: {nome}, shall we go on a treasure hunt? You look, I'll wait for you here. One thing at a time.
intro.pilu: {nome}, I'll tell you something to look for. Look carefully around you: treasures are everywhere.
intro.tango: Treasure hunt, {nome}! I'm coming too! ...No, I'll stay here. You look, slowly.

outro.bo: So many treasures, {nome}. Now each one goes back in its place, so we can find them again tomorrow.
outro.pilu: Every treasure goes back where you found it, {nome}: that's part of the game too. See you tomorrow.
outro.tango: What a hunt! {nome}, shall we put everything back? I'll... I'll keep an eye on it. See you tomorrow!
